comparisons.reason: Item 0 requires the quoted OP text to be a specific factual claim (not opinion) and requires the comment to dispute or refute it. Item 1 is quotation presence only, any OP text, and says endorsement or refutation is not required. Item 1 is therefore much broader. The null rules also differ: item 0 returns null if title/argument is missing, while item 1 returns 1 on a clear positive match when only one OP source is available.
